text: Write it down or it did not happen
detail: Every decision we make lives on a page with a note beside it. New people read the argument, not just the outcome.
Applies to our agents and to us. A conclusion nobody can check is a conclusion nobody will act on.

text: Charge for the work, not the seat
detail: The product gets better with more people in it. Pricing that fights that is pricing we have to change.

text: The fourth draft is the one
detail: We ship slower than we could and rewrite more than is comfortable. It is the only quality lever we trust.
